description: gtfs-utils is a JavaScript library for transforming GTFS schedule tables into dated trip stopovers. The public-transport contributors provide asynchronous stream processing for service calendars, calendar exceptions, trips, stop times and frequencies. The output includes stop and trip identifiers and absolute arrival and departure timestamps interpreted in the requested timezone. It can read CSV from disk or use compatible adapters for remote or archived input. Geographic coverage and service period come from the supplied feed, not a built-in network. The package is available through npm and public source code, free under ISC. Input files must be correctly sorted, and sorting checks are enabled by default. The README describes processing costs for large feeds and recommends a PostgreSQL alternative when query performance matters. These are provider observations, not performance measurements made in this review. Simulation uses include preparing event sequences for passenger-flow models and constructing reproducible timetable inputs. It relates to data-gtfs-specification and model-gtfs-kit. The documented interfaces and source tree were checked; installation and feed conversion were not tested.
